verdict.rationale: Perplexity has a dedicated rate-limits and usage-tiers docs page. It describes a self-serve upgrade path: spending more on API credits automatically moves you to higher tiers with more requests per minute, and tiers never downgrade. The pack does not show the actual per-tier numbers, and nothing documents concurrency caps. Missing for 10: specific per-tier RPM figures, documented concurrency caps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and concurrency caps with a self-serve upgrade path

citations.quote: As you spend more on API credits over time, you automatically advance to higher tiers with increased rate limits. Higher tiers unlock significantly more requests per minute, and once you reach a tier, you keep it permanently with no downgrade.
Pay-as-you-go pricing for all APIs. No subscription required.
